route_title: Cavity Re-initialization with Tight Bounds - Recovery from Optimizer Drift
compilation_rationale: Bounded route fixes 21-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 sequence. Outer mirrors initialized to 1550-nm quarter-wave optical thicknesses (~184.5 nm / ~267.2 nm); central cavity pair thicknesses (layers 7-11) optimize within ±10 nm of provided baselines. Coherent planar TMM with smatrix evaluates transmission peaks and stopbands per request.
